title: Blaupunkt 27" 4K Ultra HD 240Hz QD-OLED Gaming Monitor $875 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ JB Hi-Fi
body:
Deal: Blaupunkt 27" 4K Ultra HD 240Hz QD-OLED Gaming Monitor $875 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ JB Hi-Fi

[Kazusa] Would not buy this given that dell aw2725q is basically the same price
[alaskakyoto] Same panel except the Blaupunkt comes with a headphone jack if people care for that. But yes, Dell after-sales would probably be… safer.
[Grok] Blaupunkt Is no longer Blaupunkt.
It’s a Chinese licensee of the brand name which went bankrupt in 2015
Go Dell
[HaydosK] Please don't buy this cheap brand just for a useless headphone jack that probably sounds like trash.
[Wip3out] And it's been around $670 with cashbacks.
[AustriaBargain] It is QD. Blaupunkts #199 19 inch 1080p OLED at Officeworks is OLED though, it's one of them portable OLEDs that was originally going to be a laptop screen.
[alaskakyoto] It's QD-OLED which is better suited than traditional WOLED. Same tandem OLED panel as Alienware AW2725Q, Lenovo's UD27-10, ASUS XG27UCDMG and a bunch of others; A very good panel overall (Samsung) so I don't understand the hesitation.
[Agret] It's QD-OLED which is better suited than traditional WOLED
Not for PC desktop usage, text rendering is weird on QD-OLED due to the pixel layout
MacType will fix it for "most" things on the desktop but still some programs won't apply it
https://github.com/snowie2000/mactype/releases
[alaskakyoto] Appreciate the response. Samsung changed the subpixel layout starting this panel and has effectively fixed this issue. I myself use this panel (Lenovo UD27-10) and am very particularly about these things myself: Zero complaints whatsoever. QD-OLED has come a long way. Mac rendering is fixed by using BetterDisplay that forces HiDPI. Windows is not an issue.
[TSK7] I would spend the $120 more and get the Lenovo Legion Pro 34-inch OLED monitor. 34 inch is sweet spot
[Huntakillaz] Yeah if gaming then 1440P UW > 4K especially with current GPU prices
[TSK7] yeah 1440p gaming and movie watching, its amazing
[HaydosK] Hahaha. It's just an industry standard term.
[YoursTruly] A 27-inch would defo be good for the pp.
